pm_exper_user_1616_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: How can I handle feeling flustered when I suddenly lose my train of thought in conversations?
pm_exper_user_1616_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) When you lose your train of thought in a conversation, try taking a small pause and looking at something familiar, like a picture or object you like. This can help your mind relax before speaking again. You can also use a simple word to help continue the conversation while you remember the rest.
(b) When you feel worried because your friends are moving too fast in a game, try taking a small pause and looking at something familiar, like a picture or object you like. This can help your brain settle before you jump back in. You can also say a simple word you know well to get started again.
(c) When you feel flustered from switching between English and Spanish, try taking a small pause and looking at something familiar, like a picture or object you like. This can help your brain settle before you keep talking. You can also use a simple word you know well to keep the conversation going while you remember the rest.
(d) When you feel flustered because you’re shy meeting new people, try taking a small pause and looking at something familiar, like a picture or object you like. This can help your brain settle before you speak. You can also use a simple word you know well to keep the conversation going.
